title: Want our money and our Sunday back....
text: Want our money and our Sunday back..... Aweful. We just opened these for the cottage. The trees are so poorly made. The needles are truly like actual needles. Mom went to set up and needles into her thumb required 3 stitches. Spent the day at urgent care. These are sooooo cheap and aweful.

product_metadata.title: National Tree Company Artificial Shrub Includes Pot Base Arborvitae-48, 48-Inch, Green
features: Includes one Artificial Slim Spiral Shrub that holds a Arborvitae plant that measures 48 inches tall and 11 inches in diameter. This shrub features a dark green pot base that can be left as is or placed into a different decorative pot.
Keep your garden hassle-free with this artificial plant that requires no water, pruning or regular maintenance. Perfect for areas that would otherwise be uninhabitable for living plants.
Crafted with high quality materials, this charming artificial plant decoration is designed to last season after season.
Suitable as an indoor or covered outdoor decoration, place this artificial plant in a living room, entryway or an outdoor covered porch to add a natural accent to any area of the house.

At National Tree Company, we believe that special seasonal memories don’t have to be far and few between. This year, let our shrub decorations transform your home and covered porch while you focus on creating more of those magical moments.
